title: A general endomorphism of $\mathbb{P}^k$ has trivial iterated centralizer
summary: Fix integers $k,d\geq2$. Let $\mathrm{End}_d^k$ denote the parameter space of endomorphisms of $\mathbb{P}^k$ of algebraic degree $d$. We prove that there exists a dense Zariski open subset $U_{d,k}\subset\mathrm{End}_d^k$, defined over $\mathbb{Q}$, such that, for every $f\in U_{d,k}(\mathbb{C})$, every dominant rational self-map of $\mathbb{P}^k$ commuting with an iterate of $f$ is itself an iterate of $f$.
